notes: Intro: mid-market analytics SaaS; productized AI search for customer success + in-app help.
Background: CTO (Rahul Iyer) wants to add semantic search over product telemetry + docs. Current prototype uses open-source embeddings (Faiss) but ops cost is high.
Primary ask: embeddings at scale (nightly batch jobs for 20M events + incremental streaming), semantic search across docs and event metadata, sub-150ms P95 for in-app search queries.
Throughput targets: ~500 QPS peak for search endpoints, bulk-embedding throughput ~100k vectors/hour for nightly backfills.
Vector DB integration: wants connectors for Pinecone and Milvus; preference for turnkey Pinecone pairing but must avoid vendor lock-in. Needs easy export of vector snapshots.
Latency requirement: 95th <150ms for single-query lookups; cold-cache tail tolerance up to 400ms.
Cost sensitivity: mid-market — care about unit economics. Target ARR uplift payback within 6-9 months. Interested in batching/quantization recommendations.
Security: SSO/SAML mandatory, audit logs + KMS for key management, data residency: US only for now (may expand to EU later). SOC2 evidence required for procurement review.
Sequence so far: 2025-11-20 lead created from inbound webinar -> Discovery call 2025-11-25 (Avery + Diego). Demo of Hosted API 2025-12-08. POC proposal shared 2026-01-05.

POC plan (agreed): 6-week evaluation — Week 1: infra baseline + data schema; Week 2-3: nightly batch embed run + vector import to Pinecone; Week 4: integrate search into staging app; Week 5: load/latency test; Week 6: results + pricing conversation.
POC success metrics: 90% recall on 300 eval queries, P95 latency <200ms at 250 QPS, embedding batch completes in under 10 hours for 10M rows.

Notes from 2026-01-22 POC kickoff (ff_20260122_8877): Rahul: 'Don't want a black box — need visibility into per-token cost and traceable call IDs.' SE: Diego mapped batching options and suggested Redwood Optimize runbook.
Security review: Received initial security questionnaire 2026-02-01; engineering waiting on SOC2 report and encryption key flow diagram. Drive doc link above contains their answers.

Commercials: prefer hosted to get started; willingness to move to Dedicated within 3-6 months if unit costs align and SLA meets 99.9% uptime. Budget band discussed: $75k-$200k ARR depending on Dedicated discount and committed usage.
Quote from product lead (Maya Liu) on 2026-02-12 demo: 'Search must feel instantaneous inside the product — if it stalls users churn.' Emphasis on UX latency.

Open technical questions: 1) how does Redwood handle vector snapshot exports/imports? 2) automated re-embedding workflow for schema changes? 3) recommended quantization profile for 8-bit inference on embeddings workload?
Internal action items: Diego to send architecture diagram for Dedicated networking by 2026-03-03; Avery to schedule pricing alignment with finance 2026-03-10.
Sales tactic: push cost/perf report comparing hosted vs dedicated for their 10M vector workload; include Optimize recommendations to reduce estimated token cost.
Potential upsell: Dedicated + Optimize + increased retention + longer commit for lower per-token pricing; small managed onboarding retainer.
Tone: pragmatic, engineering-led buying group. Procurement will get involved after SOC2 docs provided.
Customer maturity: Early production — internal beta with ~3k DAU. Looking to scale search into GA in Q2 2026.
Next meeting booked: pricing + POC wrap (Avery, Diego, Rahul, Maya) 2026-03-11 (ff_20260214_1234).
